digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler integration test — idempotency oracle
propositions: After RP-02 S2 T2 moved clear_absent into binding_lifecycle.py, the idempotency test's _now_iso clock patch on binding_store no longer reaches binding_lifecycle operations, narrowing test coverage

The integration test still passes because the no-churn contract means the clock is never consulted on a healthy pass, but would fail to catch regressions where clear_absent stamps updated_at unconditionally
Patching _now_iso on both binding_store and binding_lifecycle restores the oracle's original reach and ensures mutations to clear_absent that add unconditional timestamps are caught
No other binding_store_mod-targeted patches in the test file had their subjects moved to binding_lifecycle during RP-02 S2
